fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A human-readable description of the resource.

fields.label: Failover Origin
fields.help: The Origin resource to try when the current origin cannot be reached.

fields.label: Max Attempts
fields.help: The maximum number of attempts to cache fill from this origin.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource; provided by the client when the resource is created.

fields.label: Origin Address
fields.help: A fully qualified domain name (FQDN) or IP address reachable over the public Internet, or the address of a Google Cloud Storage bucket.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The port to connect to the origin on.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.help: The protocol to use to connect to the configured origin.

fields.label: Retry Conditions
fields.help: Specifies one or more retry conditions for the configured origin.

fields.label: Aws V4 Authentication
Access Key ID
fields.help: The access key ID your origin uses to identify the key.

fields.label: Origin Region
fields.help: The name of the AWS region that your origin is in.

fields.label: Secret Access Key Version
fields.help: The Secret Manager secret version of the secret access key used by your origin.
Enable AWS Signature Version 4 origin authentication.

fields.label: Flex Shielding
Flex Shielding Regions
fields.help: Whenever possible, content will be fetched from origin and cached in or near the specified origin.
The FlexShieldingOptions to be used for all routes to this origin.

fields.label: Origin Override Action
Header Action
Request Headers To Add
Header Name
fields.help: The name of the header to add.

fields.label: Header Value
fields.help: The value of the header to add.

fields.label: Replace
fields.help: Whether to replace all existing headers with the same name.
Describes a header to add.
The header actions, including adding and removing headers, for request handled by this origin.

fields.label: URL Rewrite
Host Rewrite
fields.help: Prior to forwarding the request to the selected origin, the request's host header is replaced with contents of the hostRewrite.
The URL rewrite configuration for request that are handled by this origin.
The override actions, including url rewrites and header additions, for requests that use this origin.

fields.label: Origin Redirect
Redirect Conditions
fields.help: The set of redirect response codes that the CDN follows.
Follow redirects from this origin.

fields.label: Timeout
Connect Timeout
fields.help: The maximum duration to wait for a single origin connection to be established, including DNS lookup, TLS handshake and TCP/QUIC connection establishment.

fields.label: Max Attempts Timeout
fields.help: The maximum time across all connection attempts to the origin, including failover origins, before returning an error to the client.

fields.label: Read Timeout
fields.help: The maximum duration to wait between reads of a single HTTP connection/stream.

fields.label: Response Timeout
fields.help: The maximum duration to wait for the last byte of a response to arrive when reading from the HTTP connection/stream.
The connection and HTTP timeout configuration for this origin.
